findings.title: Unlimited Liability for Customer
findings.quote: Customer has unlimited liability for all losses, including indirect and consequential damages.
findings.rationale: The clause imposes unlimited liability on the Customer, which deviates from the preference to cap aggregate liability at fees paid in the preceding 12 months and exclude indirect damages.
findings.proposed_language: Customer's aggregate liability shall be capped at the fees paid in the preceding twelve months, and shall exclude any indirect or consequential damages.

findings.title: Unreciprocal Indemnity
findings.quote: Customer indemnifies Supplier for all claims connected to use of the service; Supplier owes no indemnity to Customer.
findings.rationale: The clause provides indemnity only from the Customer to the Supplier, with no reciprocal indemnity from the Supplier to the Customer, which does not satisfy the requirement for appropriately scoped reciprocal indemnities.
findings.proposed_language: Both parties shall indemnify each other for claims connected to their respective negligence, misconduct, or breach of this agreement.
